name: pudi-skills
description: Ishwar's Claude Code plugins: lean (build less), guardrails (engineering standards), devops (infrastructure YAML and triage), scanner (code-quality toolchain), prd (product requirements).

plugins.name: lean
plugins.description: Build-less discipline: the YAGNI ladder, an over-engineering reviewer with a shortcut-debt ledger, and a codebase-convention reader. Ships a PostToolUse hook that warns when an edit makes a Python file measurably more complex; that hook needs python3 on PATH and reports once if it is absent.

plugins.name: prd
plugins.description: Seven-section, evidence-first PRD structure with a three-persona review loop. Follows the repo's own PRD template when it has one, requires a number and a timeframe on every success metric, and marks missing evidence rather than inventing it. Split out from lean because it fires on PRD requests only, not on every coding task.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Tiered engineering policy with a PreToolUse hook. Reproducibility rules (unpinned dependencies across requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, package.json) always apply; a preference tier (leading-underscore names, __main__ blocks, __all__) can be switched off. Supports an audit mode that reports without blocking.

plugins.name: scanner
plugins.description: Code-quality scanner toolchain: add one analyzer behind a design gate, render self-contained report dashboards, rank risk hotspots from churn and complexity, and remediate high-confidence findings with a before/after re-scan. Ships a PreToolUse hook that blocks network-dependent report HTML and intact credential patterns. Only useful in a repo that has a scanner.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Write and debug infrastructure YAML — Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, docker-compose, Terraform — plus runtime triage playbooks. Ships a PreToolUse hook that blocks YAML which parses fine and means the wrong thing: unquoted version floats, tab indentation, and mutable image tags.
